Subject: Fleet slice reconnaissance & availability check — Nimble Systems (late-stage)

Folks,

Quick ask: Nimble is in late-stage negotiations and is proposing a dedicated capacity commitment if we can guarantee runway for their production launch. They want an initial dedicated slice for a 90-day ramp, target start ~2028-08-15. High level requirements from the deal team: 
- Preferred: H100-class performance for their model (roughly equivalent to 12 H100 nodes)
- Alternate config: A100-80GB x24 (if H100 is constrained)
- Sustained concurrency target: ~50 sessions, ~30 tokens/sec/session (inference-heavy)

Attached is a quick demand profile from the AE (fleet_snapshot_20280722.csv). Can you confirm:
1) What spare capacity we have in US-west and US-east for either of the two configs on those dates?
2) Lead time to pre-provision / warm a dedicated slice and any scheduler constraints for cross-pool isolation?
3) Recommended fallback (model variant, quantization, or regional failover) we should surface to the customer now?

If we can hold a soft reservation for 30 days while legal/pricing closes, that would materially improve close probability. Karthik — can you confirm the target commit size (monthly $) so ops can prioritize?

Thanks — short replies OK here.

— Marcus

Marcus —

Quick inventory snapshot based on fleet census as of 2028-07-22 (short answers up front):
- US-west (primary): H100-equivalent available capacity: ~8 nodes immediate, ~6 reclaimable over 2–3 weeks. A100-80GB available: ~40 nodes across two pools.
- US-east: H100-equivalent limited (2–3 nodes), A100-80GB plentiful (~30 nodes).
- Pre-provision warm time: ~7–10 business days for dedicated slice + validation; ops can cut that to ~4 days with prioritized pre-warm & limit on autoscale policies.

Notes / risks:
- We have a competing prior soft-hold for Q4 in US-west (internal cadence) — if Nimble insists on strict H100-only in that region we have contention risk. Recommend soft-hold + regional fallback.
- Scheduler constraints: dedicated slices can be pinned to a single AZ or spread; cross-AZ increases lead time and adds failure domains.

Actionable: I can soft-reserve an H100-equivalent slice for 30 days (no billing change) and tag it to DEAL-8473, but I need the explicit start window and whether we can accept mixed shape (H100 + A100 fallback).

I attached the fleet snapshot export for reference.

— Ben

Marc/Ben —

Operational constraints to call out for the ticket: 
- Node mapping: if we create a dedicated slice with mixed shapes we need the mapping before provisioning to avoid rebalancing windows. That adds ~24–48 hours to the lead time.
- Isolation: for enterprise customers we enforce network isolation and KMS segregation; that requires a short preflight with security (1–2 days).
- Autoscale policy: recommend a burst cap of +25% to handle initial ramp and avoid cold-start spikes hitting latency SLOs.

If we are earmarking resources I need: final shapes (primary + fallback), expected sustained RPS/QPS, SLA latency targets (p90/p99), and whether Nimble requires region pinning. Once I have that, I’ll open INF ticket and set pre-provisioning priority to P1 for DEAL-8473.

Monica
